```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```


## Configure environment. Load data.
```{r, warning=F}

source(here::here("0-config.R"))

```

```{r}

#-------------------------------
# create a zoom window, and
# a cropped version of the admin
# polygons
#-------------------------------
sf_use_s2(FALSE)
niger_dists_cr <- st_crop(niger_adm1, xmin = 0, xmax = 7,
                                    ymin = 11, ymax = 19)

#-------------------------------
# make color palette variable
#-------------------------------
pcols <- brewer_pal(palette = "YlOrRd")(9)[c(3,5,7,9)]

```


```{r map grappes}
# zoomed out overview of Niger
plot_niger_admin <- ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data=niger_adm1, color="black",lwd=0.5) +
    # geom_sf(data=niger_gadm0_sf, color="black",lwd=0.5) +
    coord_sf(crs = 4326) +
    geom_rect(aes(xmin = 0, xmax = 7, ymin = 11, ymax = 19), color = "black", fill = NA, lty = "dashed", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    # add country labels
    annotate("text",x=4,y=22, label = "Niger", fontface="bold",size=8) +
    labs(x="",y="") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_blank(),
        plot.margin = margin(0,0,0,0, "pt")
        )
    
plot_niger_admin
```

```{r map-overall}
    
# detailed zoom view, including grappes
plot_map_mortrate_1to59 <- ggplot() +
  # admin boundaries
  geom_sf(data=niger_adm2, fill=NA, color="black",lwd=0.3) +
  # cluster points
  geom_sf(data=d_sf, aes(color=deaths_per_1000_1to59, shape=tx), alpha=0.9) +
  coord_sf(crs = 4326) +
  scale_colour_gradientn(colours=pcols) +
  labs(color="Deaths per 1000", title="") +
  theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "right")

plot_map_mortrate_1to59
```

## Maps by original tx arms
```{r map-by-tx-arm}
plot_map_mortrate_1to59_Child <- ggplot() +
  # admin boundaries
  geom_sf(data=niger_adm2, fill=NA, color="black",lwd=0.3) +
  # cluster points
  geom_sf(data=d_sf %>% dplyr::filter(tx=="Child Azithro"), 
          aes(color=deaths_per_1000_1to59), alpha=0.9, size=3) +
  coord_sf(crs = 4326) +
  scale_colour_gradientn(colours=pcols, limits = c(0,150)) +
  labs(color="Deaths per 1000", title="C. Child Azithro") +
  theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "right")

plot_map_mortrate_1to59_Infant <- ggplot() +
  # admin boundaries
  geom_sf(data=niger_adm2, fill=NA, color="black",lwd=0.3) +
  # cluster points
  geom_sf(data=d_sf %>% dplyr::filter(tx=="Infant Azithro"), 
          aes(color=deaths_per_1000_1to59), alpha=0.9, size=3) +
  coord_sf(crs = 4326) +
  scale_colour_gradientn(colours=pcols, limits = c(0,150)) +
  labs(color="Deaths per 1000", title="B. Infant Azithro") +
  theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "right")

plot_map_mortrate_1to59_Placebo <- ggplot() +
  # admin boundaries
  geom_sf(data=niger_adm2, fill=NA, color="black",lwd=0.3) +
  # cluster points
  geom_sf(data=d_sf %>% dplyr::filter(tx=="Placebo"), 
          aes(color=deaths_per_1000_1to59), alpha=0.9, size=3) +
  coord_sf(crs = 4326) +
  scale_colour_gradientn(colours=pcols, limits = c(0,150)) +
  labs(color="Deaths per 1000", title="A. Placebo") +
  theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "right")

```

### Composite figure
```{r ggarrange}

fig_1_point_est <- 
  ggarrange(plot_map_mortrate_1to59_Placebo,
            plot_map_mortrate_1to59_Infant,
            plot_map_mortrate_1to59_Child,
            nrow = 1, ncol = 3, common.legend = T, legend = "right")

ggsave(filename = paste0(figure_path,"avenir-mortality-rate-point-est-map_",Sys.Date(),".pdf"), 
       fig_1_point_est,
       device = "pdf", 
       width = 250,
       height = 160,
       units = "mm")

fig_1_point_est

```

## Maps by isTreated_child tx arms
```{r map-by-tx-arm 2}
plot_map_mortrate_1to59_tx <- ggplot() +
  # admin boundaries
  geom_sf(data=niger_adm2, 
          fill=NA, 
          color="black",
          lwd=0.3) +
  # cluster points
  geom_sf(data=d_sf %>% dplyr::filter(isTreated_child=="Treatment"), 
          aes(color=deaths_per_1000_1to59), 
          alpha=0.9, 
          size=3) +
  coord_sf(crs = 4326) +
  scale_colour_gradientn(colours=pcols, limits=c(0,150)) +
  # scale_color_viridis(option = "D", 
  #                     direction = 1,
  #                     limits = c(0,150),
  #                     na.value = NA) +
  labs(color="Deaths per 1000", 
       title="A. Child Azithro") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

plot_map_mortrate_1to59_pl <- ggplot() +
  # admin boundaries
  geom_sf(data=niger_adm2, 
          fill=NA, 
          color="black",
          lwd=0.3) +
  # cluster points
  geom_sf(data=d_sf %>% dplyr::filter(isTreated_child=="Control"), 
          aes(color=deaths_per_1000_1to59), 
          alpha=0.9, 
          size=3) +
  coord_sf(crs = 4326) +
  scale_colour_gradientn(colours=pcols, limits=c(0,150)) +
  # scale_color_viridis(option = "D", 
  #                     direction = 1,
  #                     limits = c(0,150),
  #                     na.value = NA) +
  labs(color="Deaths per 1000", 
       title="B. Placebo + Infant Azithro") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

plot_map_mortrate_1to59_tx
plot_map_mortrate_1to59_pl
```

### Composite figure
```{r ggarrange}

fig_1_point_est_isTreated <- 
  ggarrange(plot_map_mortrate_1to59_tx,
            plot_map_mortrate_1to59_pl,
            nrow = 1, ncol = 2, common.legend = T, legend = "right")

ggsave(filename = paste0(figure_path,"avenir-mortality-rate-point-est-map_isTreatedchild_",Sys.Date(),".pdf"), 
       fig_1_point_est_isTreated,
       device = "pdf", 
       width = 250,
       height = 160,
       units = "mm")

fig_1_point_est_isTreated

```
